Hello guys in this video we claimed the insurance of our ns 125.
We met with an accident and then we saw our bike .
Our bike was heavily damaged and then we decide that we are going to take the claim on it..
And we finally cliamed our insurance with 0debt amount 
We have a total estimate of 49,854 rupees and 200 rupees file charge..
